comment:
* A source that reads the incoming data frames of a stream. Although this
   * class uses synchronization to safely receive incoming data frames, it is
   * not intended for use by multiple readers.

variables.name: receiveBuffer
variables.comment: Buffer to receive data from the network into. Only accessed by the reader thread.

variables.name: readBuffer
variables.comment: Buffer with readable data. Guarded by FramedStream.this.

variables.name: maxByteCount
variables.comment: Maximum number of bytes to buffer before reporting a flow control error.

variables.name: closed
variables.comment: True if the caller has closed this stream.

variables.name: finished
variables.comment:
* True if either side has cleanly shut down this stream. We will
     * receive no more bytes beyond those already in the buffer.

methods.name: public long read(Buffer sink, long byteCount) throws IOException
private void waitUntilReadable() throws IOException
methods.comment: Returns once the source is either readable or finished.

methods.name: void receive(BufferedSource in, long byteCount) throws IOException

methodNames: public long read(Buffer sink, long byteCount) throws IOException
void receive(BufferedSource in, long byteCount) throws IOException
